name: Trans India House Impex Limited
about: Trans India House Impex Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides export trading services in India and internationally. It exports ceramic tiles; packaging, such as flexible intermediate bulk containers and woven polypropylene bags; textiles and fabrics; dehydrated vegetables, including garlic, ginger, cabbage, beet root, mint, spinch, curry, green chilliy, aamchur dry mango, tomato, tamarind, coriander, carrot, and fenugreek, as well as white, red, and pink onion; and rice under the Teranga Rizblanc Rice brand. The company also provides trading of footwear; and import, export, merchant trading, and logistics services, including shipping and forwarding, cargo clearance, port and terminal, multimodel logistics, warehousing, empty yard, fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), and shipping agent services. The company was formerly known as IO System Limited and changed its name to Trans India House Impex Limited in August 2022. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
